item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is choosing a cotton shirt to wear to school on a hot summer afternoon in Jaipur.
She wants the shirt that helps her gain the least amount of heat from sunlight.
Which shirt should she choose, and why?

options.A: a black shirt, because dark colours reflect most of the heat that falls on them
options.B: a white shirt, because light colours reflect most of the heat that falls on them
options.C: a black shirt, because dark colours absorb most of the heat that falls on them
options.D: either shirt, because the colour of clothing does not affect how much heat it absorbs
